ev.q: Omicron-associated mutations were documented during November 2021
Thirteen Omicron-associated mutations were detected in a sample collected on December 2, 2021.
by December 16, Omicron-associated mutations were detected at 19 of 21 sewersheds.
The number of Omicron-positive sites, as well as the number of Omicron-associated mutations detected, increased over the subsequent 2 weeks.
